title: Choose a walking map
body: A walking resource for planning a route. Compare scale, symbols and accessible paths before setting out.

title: Read the weather before a walk
body: This walking resource explains rain, wind and local forecasts. Check daylight and change your plans when conditions worsen.

title: Pack for a day outdoors
body: Use this walking resource as a checklist for water, food, layers and a charged phone. Bring any medication you need.

title: Check route access
body: A walking resource for checking gates, surfaces, gradients, toilets and rest stops. Confirm the details that matter for your visit.

title: Estimate walking time
body: This walking resource is a simple tool for thinking about distance, climbing and breaks. Allow extra time for the slowest member of your group.

title: Watch wildlife with care
body: A walking resource about keeping distance, leaving nests alone and following local signs. Keep dogs under control near animals.

title: Leave a route ready for others
body: A walking resource checklist for taking litter home, closing gates and respecting local communities. Stay on marked paths where requested.
